mechanism_name: Weekend liquidity-participation cycle (session-conditioned short book on the UTC-H1 grid)
mechanism_story: WHO IS FORCED TO SELL / SLOW TO REACT: On UTC weekends the marginal professional liquidity provider is absent or quoting at reduced size: institutional market-making desks that hedge BTC/ETH perps against weekday-only spot, ETF and OTC flow operate on weekday business clocks, so weekend order books clear with retail-only taker flow against pulled quotes. Leveraged long holders facing 48h of funding payments and gap risk with no institutional bid are the slow/forced de-ridders who work exits before the weekend and into thin books. WHY THE EFFECT EXISTS: participation is calendar-structured, not continuous — inventory that cannot be hedged until Monday must be compensated by a risk premium expressed as wider spreads and lower mids across the weekend window, producing a persistent negative per-weekend drift into Monday re-opening. This is a liquidity-supply clock, not a price pattern: no price, VWAP-displacement, run, flow-imbalance or size variable is consumed. WHAT OBSERVABLE MEASURES IT: the weekend session flag on the published UTC-H1 grid — a short position entered at the Friday 22:00 bucket VWAP and covered at the Monday 00:00 bucket VWAP, per symbol, realized drift across the ~52 weekends of S0, compared against a randomized session-boundary sham of identical duration. WHEN IT MUST FAIL: when weekend flow becomes institutionally served (24/7 hedging desks, weekend-quoted OTC/ETF-linked liquidity) the premium is arbitraged away; in retail-momentum regimes weekend directional flow flips sign; and deterministically whenever the per-weekend drift is smaller than the per-weekend round-trip taker cost at tier 2.0.
universe: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT on Binance USD-M perps, each traded independently (no cross-symbol leg); panel per symbol: 8,760 UTC-H1 rows, S0 2025-08-22..2026-08-21.
clock: H1 (decision every hourly bucket; the book holds a 26-bucket weekend window spanning H1 buckets; no daily resampling).
warmup: 0 decisions of panel lookback consumed — the trigger is a pure calendar session flag derived from day_utc/hour_utc of the decision bucket, known at bucket open. The harness fold structure (3 chronological folds, +/-1 UTC day purge) is respected; no warmup rows are needed.
features_and_lags: Inputs (section-2 column names only): hour_utc, day_utc of the decision bucket. These are clock attributes known at bucket open — no bucket-close observable is consumed, so the availability law (decision at bucket t may use rows with close_ts <= t) is satisfied trivially and there is no same-bucket close peeking. Post-extraction derivation used (allowed class 'session flags'): weekend_flag(t) = 1 if (day_utc(t)=Friday AND hour_utc(t)>=22) OR day_utc(t) in {Saturday, Sunday}, else 0. No lags, no rolling ratios, no price/flow/size columns.
entry_exit_fills: ANCHOR entry rule: at the close of the H1 bucket with day_utc=Friday and hour_utc=21 (decision time t), if weekend_flag fires for the upcoming window, enter SHORT 1 unit notional per symbol. Fill timing: next-bucket VWAP default — the short is filled at the Friday 22:00 bucket's published vwap. Exit/holding rule: hold exactly 26 buckets (Friday 22:00 through Sunday 23:00 inclusive); cover at the Monday 00:00 bucket's published vwap (decision at Sunday 23:00 close). No re-entry inside the week; no pyramiding; position is short-only, symmetric 1 unit on each symbol independently. Force-flat: any open position is closed at the last published vwap before each fold-boundary purge zone (+/-1 full UTC day around internal fold boundaries), then the book resumes on the next qualifying calendar boundary after the purge.
costs: Taker fee charged EXACTLY ONCE PER FILL (acknowledged). Schedule: 5.0 bps baseline fee with tier multipliers x1.0/x1.5/x2.0 and slip floors 1/1/2 ticks; TIER 2.0 IS THE PRIMARY BOOK (10.0 bps + 2-tick slip floor per fill). Stress multipliers apply to BOOKED PnL. Two taker fills per symbol per weekend (entry + cover).
anchor: For each symbol s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT} independently: short 1 unit at the vwap of the Friday hour_utc=22 bucket; cover at the vwap of the Monday hour_utc=00 bucket; ~52 weekend events per symbol over S0 (365 days, 52 Saturdays + 52 Sundays populated). All other buckets flat. Fills at next-bucket VWAP, once per fill, tier 2.0 costs. Force-flat at fold edges per entry_exit_fills.
neighbour: Same mechanism (weekend liquidity-participation cycle short), different frozen window parameters: enter SHORT at the vwap of the Friday hour_utc=20 bucket (decision at Friday 19:00 close), cover at the vwap of the Monday hour_utc=02 bucket (decision at Monday 01:00 close) — a 30-bucket weekend exposure. Same symbols, same fills, same once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs, same force-flat law. Frozen; not re-optimized.
control: Randomized session-boundary sham (the mechanism class is session-conditioned, so the convenient explanation to kill is 'any 26-bucket weekly short window earns the same — it is volatility/seasonality, not the weekend boundary'). Sham book: identical mechanics, symbols, holding duration (26 buckets), fill timing, once-per-fill tier-2.0 costs and force-flat law; but each week's window start is drawn with a seeded PRNG (numpy default_rng, fixed seed 17040001, drawn once over S0, frozen) uniformly over all 144 hourly offsets per week that do not overlap the true anchor window; entry at the drawn offset's bucket vwap, cover 26 buckets later at the bucket vwap. G11 contract: if the sham reproduces the anchor (same sign AND |sham pooled expectancy| >= 0.5 x |anchor pooled expectancy|), the family DIES.
exposure_series_spec: Conditioning exposure series for D2 novelty measurement, per symbol s in {BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT}, aligned to decision bucket t on the UTC-H1 grid: e_t^s = -1 if (day_utc(t) == 'Friday' AND hour_utc(t) >= 22) OR day_utc(t) in {'Saturday','Sunday'}; else e_t^s = 0. Pooled series e_t = vertical concatenation of e_t^BTCUSDT and e_t^ETHUSDT in symbol-then-time order. This is the exact signed calendar-flag series the anchor book holds; it is a deterministic function of the published hour_utc/day_utc columns, so D2 can compute it and its pooled |rho| against every forbidden conditioning exposure (funding carry, tsmom, displacement, flow, size, OI families) directly from the panel.
falsification_rule: Pre-registered and mechanical; the family DIES if ANY of: (1) G11: the randomized session-boundary sham reproduces the anchor — same sign AND |sham pooled after-cost expectancy| >= 0.5 x |anchor pooled after-cost expectancy| (tier 2.0, pooled over symbols and folds). (2) Anchor pooled after-cost expectancy <= 0 at tier 2.0 (G1). (3) G12: pooled |rho| > 0.20 between the exposure_series_spec series and ANY forbidden-inventory conditioning exposure, measured at D2. (4) Coverage fail-closed: fewer than 12 scored weekend events in any single fold (calendar coverage insufficient to test the session boundary).
expected_failure_interpretation: A REJECT means the weekend liquidity-participation cycle carries no after-cost edge at taker tier 2.0 in S0: either the weekend risk premium was arbitraged away in the 2025-26 ETF-era regime, or it is smaller than weekend round-trip taker costs, or the sham reproduces the anchor and the book was harvesting a generic weekly volatility/seasonality artifact rather than the weekend boundary specifically. In the sham-reproduction case the session-structure information source itself is disconfirmed for this universe; no re-parameterization of the window is licensed (that would be rescue by session-subset/threshold re-label).
expected_failure_mode: Cost domination (named risk of the intraday frontier). Turnover estimate per decision: 2 fills per symbol per 168-bucket week = 0.012 fills per decision-hour per symbol; pooled 2 symbols = 0.024 fills per pooled decision-hour; ~208 fills/year pooled. Per weekend round trip: 2 fills per symbol = 2 x (10 bps + 2-tick slip floor) at tier 2.0, ~20+ bps per symbol-weekend, ~40+ bps per pooled 2-symbol weekend — against a documented weekend seasonality historically of order 10-50 bps, so the primary kill mode is per-weekend drift < per-weekend tier-2.0 round-trip cost, with fold-level MDD stress applied on top.
